headline: International Gemological Institute shares rally 16% in two days on strong quarterly results
hook: Profit jumps 43 percent in September quarter
summary: International Gemological Institute shares rose 6% on Friday following a 10% gain in the previous session, bringing the two-day total advance to 16.5%. The rally was driven by September-quarter earnings showing a 43% year-on-year increase in profit to ₹185.8 crore. Revenue for the same period grew 31% to ₹398 crore. The stock is currently trading just 3.5% below its 52-week high.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings push stock near 52-week high

headline: International Gemological Institute hits 10% upper circuit on strong Q2 results
hook: Profit jumps 43 percent in second quarter
summary: International Gemological Institute shares hit a 10% upper circuit at ₹353.20 after reporting a 43% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹185.8 crore. Revenue grew 31% to ₹398 crore during the quarter, driven by healthy demand and strong operational execution. For Indian retail investors, the sharp earnings growth signals robust business momentum in the gemological certification sector.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings drive sharp gains in listed gemological stock

headline: IGI posts 43% jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 185 crore
hook: Strong festive demand lifts diamond sales
summary: International Gemological Institute reported a 43.14% increase in profit after tax and a 31% rise in operational revenue for the quarter. Demand for both lab-grown and natural diamonds stayed robust ahead of the festive season. Retailers and manufacturers expect strong sales growth across their product segments as consumer buying picks up. This performance highlights steady momentum in the gems and jewelry sector.
why_it_matters: Jewellery stock sentiment gets a festive season boost
winners_losers: Diamond retailers gain / high-cost players hurt

headline: IGIL files ICRA monitoring agency report for September quarter
hook: Quarterly fund usage report submitted by IGIL
summary: Indo Global Investment & Logistics has submitted the monitoring agency report issued by ICRA Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing is made pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. This routine disclosure tracks the utilization of proceeds raised by the company. For retail investors, such filings ensure transparency regarding the deployment of previously raised capital.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing showing fund utilization status for IGIL.
